purpose: fresh-seed validation of corr40-split-v3 (corr40-split-v2 with a sample-accurate, block-invariant body splice hold) before any result on these seeds is seen

pass_rule.targets: T1, T2, T4 PASS and T3 within the regression ceiling, all inputs (study fixtures + fresh seeds)
pass_rule.block_invariance: BlockInvariance: corr40-split-v3 output bit-identical to fixed block 128 for every pattern (fixed 1/37/64/100/256/512/1024/2048/4096, random 1-512 seeds 1-3, random 1-4096) on every fresh-seed input (3 holdout modes x 3 seeds + long notes) x 3 instruments x 3 rates x 4 shifts
pass_rule.report_only: splice-collision counts (both paths searching in one callback) at block 64/128/256 vs v2; worst callback thread CPU

rules: single run per engine; no parameter, metric, threshold or input change after seeing results
